The '''Queen's Own Armored Cavalry Troop''' was a [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] unit serving the [[Kitel Phard Dynasty]]. It was part of the [[Atrisian Assault Corps]], alongside the [[Imperial Atrisian Grenadiers]] and [[His Majesty's Roto-gunners]].<ref name="ROE" />
